name: Microfinance field operations

problems.words: I do not know where my field officers actually are during the day
quick_ideas: Have each officer share the day's planned groups with the branch each morning, so there is a plan to compare against
Review planned versus completed visits every evening, so a missed visit surfaces the same day, not a week later.

workzap_build.text: a field visit sheet on the officer's phone where they would see planned groups, check in openly at each centre meeting, and mark visits done or not done with a reason, rolled up daily per branch, with no live tracking.

problems.ask_first: How many field officers does each branch have?
problems.free_stops: Check-in design and reason codes are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare each officer's morning route note with the centres actually reported by day end, so field visibility problems show by officer and area.
Give one branch person the job of keeping the day's route list in one notebook, so everyone checks the same plan.

problems.words: Officers say they visited a group but the collection does not match
quick_ideas: Have the group total confirmed at the centre meeting itself, so the figure is agreed before it travels
Make surprise supervisor visits to a few centres, so the control is seen to exist.

workzap_build.text: cash_reconciliation — Group-total collection capture at the centre meeting feeding the branch day-end, with mismatches flagged right away.

problems.ask_first: Is the mismatch mostly with a few officers, or across many groups?
problems.free_stops: Confirmation steps and matching rules are in the solution document; pi notes the control gap, never names individuals.

extra_ideas.text: Note each centre where visit claims and collection totals do not line up, so supervisors see which routes need closer checking.
Give one supervisor the job of logging centre visit proof in one register, so disputed field work has a single branch record.

problems.words: Officers carry a lot of cash back to branch and it is risky
quick_ideas: Note what time cash reaches the branch each day, so late returns are visible
Ask your management which repayment channels the programme already allows besides cash, so less is carried by hand.

workzap_build.text: A branch day-end cash handover and deposit log with time stamps and variance flags per officer role.

problems.ask_first: Do officers carry cash mostly from distant centres, or from every centre?
problems.free_stops: The handover log design is in the solution document; pi records no cash movement routes or times.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many cash return handovers happen after the branch closing routine starts this week, so risky timing across routes becomes visible.
Give one branch person the job of noting every cash handover in one notebook before officers leave, so returns stop drifting across desks.

problems.words: Collections written in a field register are typed into the MIS days later
quick_ideas: Time how long the typing takes each day, so the cost of double entry is clear
Agree a fixed same-day entry cut-off, so the backlog stops growing.

workzap_build.text: Collection totals captured on phone at the centre meeting and passed into the MIS, so registers are not retyped.

problems.ask_first: Is the typing delay worst at certain branches, or at all of them?
problems.free_stops: What the MIS can accept and how the link works is assessed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare the date in the field register with the date it is typed, so you see the real delay on collections entry.
Give one person the same day entry list in one notebook, so registers are typed before another day's papers arrive.

problems.words: Overdue figures are a week old by the time head office sees them
quick_ideas: Pick the two or three aggregate figures head office needs daily, so attention goes to those
Send them each evening even if rough, so decisions are not waiting for the full report.

workzap_build.text: a daily branch summary of visits planned versus done, collections versus due and deposits made, in totals only, with a side-by-side view of areas.

problems.ask_first: Is the delay mostly in collecting figures at branch level, or in the area office sending them on?
problems.free_stops: Which figures feed it and from where is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note when each branch sends overdue figures and when head office sees them, so the reporting delay is pinned to a handover point.
Give one head office person the job of collecting overdue figures into one running list each evening, so chasing stops bouncing between people.

problems.words: Head office keeps asking for the same report in a different format
quick_ideas: Collect every format requested this quarter in one place, so the overlap is obvious
Propose one standard format to head office, so branches report once.

workzap_build.text: One record sheet per branch that produces each required report format without extra work.

problems.ask_first: Did just a couple of different formats come in this quarter, or many?
problems.free_stops: Format mapping is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count which report lines head office asks for again in different layouts, so repeated rework is clear to both sides.
Give one branch person one notebook page for every recurring report request, so old formats are found quickly when head office asks again.

problems.words: Disbursement files wait for approval at the area office for days
quick_ideas: Note the date each file leaves the branch and arrives back, so the waiting point is visible
Hand every file over with a list of what is inside, so returns for missing items drop.

workzap_build.text: workflow_automation — A file movement tracker showing where each file is, who has it and how long it has waited, with a document checklist per file type.

problems.ask_first: Do files from certain branches wait longest, or from every branch?
problems.free_stops: Stages and checklist contents are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many files sit at branch, in transit, and at area office today, so the queue location is obvious.
Give one branch person the handover log for every disbursement file, so waiting files are chased from one place.

problems.words: Officers' travel and fuel claims are hard to verify
quick_ideas: Ask officers to claim against their recorded visits, so every claim has a reason attached
Review claims weekly rather than monthly, so oddities are fresh.

workzap_build.text: A travel and fuel claim log tied to completed visits, with approval and a flag for claims without matching visits.

problems.ask_first: Are claims hard to check for all officers, or only those covering far areas?
problems.free_stops: Claim rules and approval flow are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare claimed travel days with recorded field visit days this week, so mismatches stand out without discussing any officer personally.
Give one branch person one weekly claims list to check against visit records, so reimbursement questions are settled while the week is fresh.

problems.words: Head office instructions get lost in WhatsApp groups
quick_ideas: Post official instructions in one channel only, so staff know where to look
Ask each branch to acknowledge important circulars, so you know who has seen them.

workzap_build.text: A circulars channel with read confirmation per branch and reminders to those who have not acknowledged.

problems.ask_first: Do instructions get lost mostly in busy group chats, or in direct messages?
problems.free_stops: Channel set-up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many head office instructions were repeated to branches this week, so the cost of missed messages is clear.
Give one branch person the job of copying every head office instruction into one notebook, so staff have one place to check later.

problems.words: Field officers leave after a year and new ones do the paperwork wrong
quick_ideas: Write down the five things a new officer most often gets wrong, so training targets them
Pair each new officer with an experienced one for their first weeks, so groups see continuity.

workzap_build.text: An officer onboarding checklist with short process guides and a record of which files are returned and why.

problems.ask_first: Do new officers mostly get loan files wrong, or daily collection records?
problems.free_stops: Guide content and tracking are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count which paperwork mistakes appear most in each new officer's first month, so refresher coaching targets the forms wasting branch time.
Give one senior clerk the job of checking every new officer's paperwork at day end, so errors are corrected before files pile up.

never_say: Anything on interest, service charges, loan sizes, products, eligibility or credit decisions.
Any recovery tactic, pressure approach or legal action against borrowers.
Any request for borrowers' names, CNIC, addresses, phone numbers, loan amounts or repayment histories.
Live location tracking of officers or covert monitoring.
Anything on SBP or SECP regulation beyond noting reporting effort.

sample_reply.person: FOs ki field visits ka koi hisaab nahi rehta, kuch hal hai is ka?
sample_reply.pi:
Zaroor, ye sambhal sakta hai, aur pehla qadam aasan hai.
Pehle, har officer subah apne din ke groups branch ko bata de, taake shaam ko planned aur mukammal visits mila sakein.
Doosra, har shaam yeh milan ek baar dekh lein, taake miss hua visit usi din pata chale, hafte baad nahi.
Is mein Workzap ye shamil kar sakta hai: officers khule taur pe har centre meeting pe check-in karein aur aap ko har branch ki roz ki report mile, borrowers ka koi data liye baghair.
